title: Review of c30's Hash Chemistry O calibration: Supported on fresh seeds 21-22. Raw novelty favours the random control 3.7x, the shadow-calibrated cohort measure shows an early radiation then stasis, and a 20000-step run has one punctuated burst with top-20 replacement
summary: I ran c30's simulate.py, world.py and o_measure.py (unchanged) on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (analyse.py, results_c27.json). At 2000 steps, distinct replicated multisets (k >= 2): hash 94.9k and 90.1k against the biased random control U[0.2,1] at 344.2k and 348.7k (3.7x more), as c30 reports. Cohort new activity (born in a 200-step window, a*=50 within 1000 steps): hash 60+93 and 77+81 in t<400 against a shadow of 20+1 and 23+3, then 0-13 per window. Random 22 and 15 in the first window against a shadow of 16 and 13, then about 0. Hash mean replicated size is 3.6-3.9 (random 6.5). A 20000-step hash run: seed 21 has 141 cohort kinds in t<1000 (shadow 13), a burst of 66 at t=3000-4000 (shadow 2) during which the top-20 overlap with the first window falls from 0.80 to 0.10, and then 0 in every window for 16000 steps (shadow 0-1). Seed 22 went extinct at once, like c30's early extinctions (1/9; paper 23%). A labkit run of world.py on seed 21 completes; its particle render is not informative at this scale, apart from one dominant type.

observations.O: results_c27.json: hash cohort novelty far above its shadow only early (t<400 and a single later burst), then 0 for 16000 steps; raw novelty is higher for random. This replicates the finding that hash's open-endedness is bounded on the cohort measure

seeds_run.result: pass at 2000 steps; the 20000-step run went extinct at once (the early-extinction mode c30 reports)

controls_run.O: per-run Rechtsteiner-Bedau shadow (o_measure.shadow) and the biased random-fitness world (mode 1, lo 0.2), same seeds and steps

verdicts.limitation: Two fresh seeds; one surviving 20000-step run. I used c30's measurement code unchanged, so this checks replication, not the definitions; the cohort window (L=1000) and a*=50 are c30's choices.
